title: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era

claims.claim: Sequoia announced a broad overhaul in a memo posted to X, which includes closing its London office and shutting down its scout program.

evidence.quote: Sequoia this week announced a broad overhaul in a memo posted to X, a move that includes closing its London office and shutting down its scout program.

claims.claim: Sequoia pioneered the scouts model 17 years ago.

evidence.quote: That’s partly because 17 years ago, Sequoia pioneered the scouts model, in which select founders and operators write checks on the firm’s behalf.

claims.claim: VC Sheel Mohnot wrote on X that the scout program never made sense to him and that other firms will likely shutter theirs too.
Andreessen Horowitz rolled out a global scout network aimed at spotting opportunities in the U.S. and smaller European hubs.

evidence.quote: Rival firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), for instance, rolled out a global scout network aimed at spotting opportunities in the U.S. and also in smaller European hubs.

claims.claim: a16z partner Gabriel Vasquez told TechCrunch earlier this year that the firm had revamped its program to give scouts more budget while reducing their number.

evidence.quote: But a16z partner Gabriel Vasquez told TechCrunch earlier this year that the firm had revamped its program to double down “on the best people.” Under this new approach, Vasquez explained, scouts get more resources but are also expected to be more active... “They get more budget, but we have reduced the number,” he said.

claims.claim: Station F boss Roxanne Varza was a Sequoia scout from 2020 to 2025.
